text: どうくつには　めずらしい　こおりの　ポケモンが　いましてね　それが　めあてで　くる　ひとも　おおいんです

structure.jp: どうくつには　めずらしい　こおりの　ポケモンが　いましてね
structure.en: there are rare Ice Pokémon in the cave, you see

structure.jp: それが　めあてで　くる　ひとも
structure.en: people who come with those as their goal, too

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: それが　めあてで　くる　ひと
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing, like 'who' in English. それが めあてで くる ひと = 'people who come here for those'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: Ending a part in て joins it to what comes next, like 'and'; いまして is the polite version. いましてね = 'there are, you see, and'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んです is the polite form of のだ, used when explaining how things are. おおいんです = 'there are many, you see'.
